introduction.situation: Knowledge about arts and literature consists of claims about works: how they are made, how they look or are structured, what they mean, where and for whom they exist, and how they are judged.
introduction.complication: The inherited groupings mix these features with library classes, residual buckets and container headings, so the same topic sits in several places and no one dimension organises the field.
introduction.question: How should every topic in arts and literature be placed by the feature of the work it is about?
introduction.answer: Arts and literature is divided by the feature of the work a claim is about, running outward from the material object to judgment: medium and making, form, meaning, context and reception, and value.

governing_thought: Arts and literature is divided by the feature of the work a claim is about, running outward from the material object to judgment: medium and making, form, meaning, context and reception, and value.

key_line.mece_dimension: what feature of the work the sentence is about
key_line.rank_note: The pillars run from the material object outward to judgment of the work.

points.statement: Medium and making is the feature of a work concerned with the material, technique and process by which it is produced.
points.name: Medium and making is the feature of a work concerned with the material, technique and process by which it is produced.

support.rank_note: Sections run from material visual objects through screen, live performance and writing to sound.

points.statement: Medium and making in visual and material art concerns works produced by shaping physical materials with hand, tool or lens.
points.name: Medium and making in visual and material art concerns works produced by shaping physical materials with hand, tool or lens.

support.rank_note: Subsections run from fine art media to craft, print and photographic processes.

points.statement: Medium and making in fine art covers painting, sculpture and drawing as the core physical media of visual art.
points.name: Medium and making in fine art covers painting, sculpture and drawing as the core physical media of visual art.

support.rank_note: The broad visual art field comes first, followed by its particular media.

points.statement: Medium and making in craft, print and lens-based practice concerns works produced through reproducible or artisanal technical processes.
points.name: Medium and making in craft, print and lens-based practice concerns works produced through reproducible or artisanal technical processes.

support.rank_note: Handwork comes first, then printing, then photographic capture.

points.statement: Medium and making in screen and digital media concerns works produced with cameras, computers and interactive technologies.
points.name: Medium and making in screen and digital media concerns works produced with cameras, computers and interactive technologies.

support.rank_note: The broad field comes first, then screen production, effects and interactive digital work.

points.statement: Interactive and digital-art work is made with computing technology, such as games, animation, electronic art and interactive media.
points.name: Interactive and digital-art work is made with computing technology, such as games, animation, electronic art and interactive media.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure across the computing-based forms.

points.statement: Medium and making in performance concerns works produced live through the bodies and actions of performers.
points.name: Medium and making in performance concerns works produced live through the bodies and actions of performers.

support.rank_note: The broad field comes first, then applied theatre and performance art.

points.statement: Medium and making in writing concerns works produced by composing text for creative, digital, site-based or professional purposes.
points.name: Medium and making in writing concerns works produced by composing text for creative, digital, site-based or professional purposes.

support.rank_note: The broad field comes first, then creative, digital, site-based and professional writing.

points.statement: Professional and technical writing covers work where the feature in focus is informing audiences through journalism or specialised documentation.
points.name: Professional and technical writing covers work where the feature in focus is informing audiences through journalism or specialised documentation.

support.rank_note: Ordered as listed in ANZSRC code sequence.

points.statement: Medium and making in music concerns works produced as organised sound through composition, performance and recording.
points.name: Medium and making in music concerns works produced as organised sound through composition, performance and recording.

support.rank_note: The art of music comes first, then the practices that make it.

points.statement: Music practice covers work where the feature in focus is the making, performing, and recording of music.
points.name: Music practice covers work where the feature in focus is the making, performing, and recording of music.

support.rank_note: Ordered as listed in ANZSRC code sequence.

points.title: Medium and making

points.statement: Form is the feature of a work concerned with its design, structure, genre and style as it appears to the audience.
points.name: Form is the feature of a work concerned with its design, structure, genre and style as it appears to the audience.

support.rank_note: Visual form comes before textual form, following the order of the medium pillar.

points.statement: Form in visual works is the arrangement of design elements, colour and visible effects that an audience perceives.
points.name: Form in visual works is the arrangement of design elements, colour and visible effects that an audience perceives.

support.rank_note: Elements of design come first, then colour, then resulting conditions and effects.

points.statement: Form in texts is the genre and type of writing that shapes how a written work appears to its readers.
points.name: Form in texts is the genre and type of writing that shapes how a written work appears to its readers.

support.rank_note: Genre writing for general readers comes before writing for younger readers.

points.statement: Popular, genre, young adult and juvenile fiction are classified by the type of writing and the readership it is aimed at.
points.name: Popular, genre, young adult and juvenile fiction are classified by the type of writing and the readership it is aimed at.

support.rank_note: Ordered by structure, not by degree.

points.statement: Literary studies defined by the type of text analyse how its kind and structure shape a written work for readers.
points.name: Literary studies defined by the type of text analyse how its kind and structure shape a written work for readers.

support.rank_note: Kinds are listed by approach without ranking.

points.statement: Literary genres are the familiar forms in which written works are composed and read.
points.name: Literary genres are the familiar forms in which written works are composed and read.

points.title: Form

points.statement: Meaning is the feature of a work concerned with what it represents, expresses and conveys through ideas and theory.
points.name: Meaning is the feature of a work concerned with what it represents, expresses and conveys through ideas and theory.

support.rank_note: Theories of meaning come before the represented ideas they explain.

points.statement: Meaning is explained by theoretical approaches that account for how visual art and cultural images produce significance.
points.name: Meaning is explained by theoretical approaches that account for how visual art and cultural images produce significance.

support.rank_note: Theory of visual art comes before theory of cultural representation.

points.statement: Theory and representation studies examine how images, identities and meanings are produced and conceptualised in culture.
points.name: Theory and representation studies examine how images, identities and meanings are produced and conceptualised in culture.

points.statement: Art history, theory and criticism not elsewhere classified
points.name: Art history, theory and criticism not elsewhere classified

support.rank_note: Ordered from visual cultures to general cultural theory.

points.statement: Meaning is carried by the ideas, themes and values that culture associates with works and that the works themselves convey.
points.name: Meaning is carried by the ideas, themes and values that culture associates with works and that the works themselves convey.

support.rank_note: A single section of associated concepts; this pillar is completed by the theory section above.

points.statement: Common themes are the recurring subjects, such as love, death and identity, that works explore.
points.name: Common themes are the recurring subjects, such as love, death and identity, that works explore.

points.title: Meaning

points.statement: Context and reception is the feature of a work concerned with the place, language, time, industry and audience in which it is produced and received.
points.name: Context and reception is the feature of a work concerned with the place, language, time, industry and audience in which it is produced and received.

support.rank_note: Sections run from place and language of origin through cultural movement to industry and audience.

points.statement: Context and reception by place and language groups literary works according to the region or tongue in which they were written.
points.name: Context and reception by place and language groups literary works according to the region or tongue in which they were written.

support.rank_note: Subsections move from Asia through Africa and the Middle East to Europe and the English-speaking world.

points.statement: Context and reception in East Asia covers literatures written in Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
points.name: Context and reception in East Asia covers literatures written in Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

support.rank_note: Listed in a stable regional order.

points.statement: Context and reception in South and South-East Asia covers Indian, Indonesian and other South-East Asian literatures.
points.name: Context and reception in South and South-East Asia covers Indian, Indonesian and other South-East Asian literatures.

support.rank_note: South Asia comes before South-East Asia.

points.statement: Context and reception in Africa and the Middle East covers literatures written across these neighbouring regions.
points.name: Context and reception in Africa and the Middle East covers literatures written across these neighbouring regions.

support.rank_note: Africa comes before the Middle East.

points.statement: Context and reception in Europe covers classical, Central and Eastern European, French, German and Italian literatures.
points.name: Context and reception in Europe covers classical, Central and Eastern European, French, German and Italian literatures.

support.rank_note: Classical antiquity and the east come before the western European languages.

points.statement: Central and Eastern European literature (incl. Russian)
points.name: Central and Eastern European literature (incl. Russian)

points.statement: Context and reception in the English-speaking and Iberian-language world covers British, Irish, North American, Australasian and other literatures in English, Spanish and Portuguese.
points.name: Context and reception in the English-speaking and Iberian-language world covers British, Irish, North American, Australasian and other literatures in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

support.rank_note: British and Irish literature comes first, then literatures that grew from it.

points.statement: Australian literature (excl. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander literature)
points.name: Australian literature (excl. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander literature)

points.statement: Literary studies of works defined by their language of composition, covering Spanish and Portuguese literature as well as literatures written in English beyond the major national traditions.
points.name: Literary studies of works defined by their language of composition, covering Spanish and Portuguese literature as well as literatures written in English beyond the major national traditions.

points.statement: Context and reception through cultural place and movement concerns how works arise from regions, migration and colonial encounter.
points.name: Context and reception through cultural place and movement concerns how works arise from regions, migration and colonial encounter.

support.rank_note: Place comes first, then movement of peoples and colonial legacies.

points.statement: Place-based cultural studies analyse culture in relation to particular regions, nations, environments and global flows.
points.name: Place-based cultural studies analyse culture in relation to particular regions, nations, environments and global flows.

points.statement: Cultural studies of nation and region
points.name: Cultural studies of nation and region

support.rank_note: Ordered from the whole discipline to regional then global scales.

points.statement: Migration and postcolonial studies investigate cultural encounters, movement of peoples and the legacies of colonialism.
points.name: Migration and postcolonial studies investigate cultural encounters, movement of peoples and the legacies of colonialism.

support.rank_note: Ordered from migrant experience to intercultural contact to postcolonial critique.

points.statement: Context and reception through industry and audience concerns how works are produced, distributed, consumed and read.
points.name: Context and reception through industry and audience concerns how works are produced, distributed, consumed and read.

support.rank_note: Industry and policy come first, then media culture, then readership and material production of texts.

points.statement: Policy, industry and consumption studies look at how culture is organised, produced and used in economic and everyday life.
points.name: Policy, industry and consumption studies look at how culture is organised, produced and used in economic and everyday life.

points.statement: Cultural studies of agriculture, food and wine
points.name: Cultural studies of agriculture, food and wine

support.rank_note: Ordered from policy to industry to everyday consumption.

points.statement: Literary and cultural study fields defined by readership or material production analyse the circumstances in which texts are produced and received.
points.name: Literary and cultural study fields defined by readership or material production analyse the circumstances in which texts are produced and received.

points.title: Context and reception

points.statement: Value is the feature of a work concerned with how it is judged, studied historically and assigned standing within culture.
points.name: Value is the feature of a work concerned with how it is judged, studied historically and assigned standing within culture.

support.rank_note: Visual art comes before screen and performance and then music, following the order of the medium pillar.

points.statement: Value in visual art is assigned through its history and through critical judgment of individual works.
points.name: Value in visual art is assigned through its history and through critical judgment of individual works.

support.rank_note: The combined field comes first, then criticism and history.

points.statement: Value in screen and performance is assigned through scholarly study and criticism of films, theatre and dance.
points.name: Value in screen and performance is assigned through scholarly study and criticism of films, theatre and dance.

support.rank_note: Cinema comes first, then theatre, then dance, following the medium pillar.

points.statement: Value in music is assigned through scholarly, historical and critical writing about musical works and traditions.
points.name: Value in music is assigned through scholarly, historical and critical writing about musical works and traditions.

support.rank_note: Musicology comes before the wider literature on music.

points.title: Value

method_line.statement: Method line holds knowledge about how music as a discipline is studied empirically, taught and learned by students.
method_line.rank_note: Empirical research on musical minds comes first, then educational research, then practical instruction.

field_check.governing_thought: Arts and literature is divided by the feature of the work a claim is about, running outward from the material object to judgment: medium and making, form, meaning, context and reception, and value.
key_line: Medium and making is the feature of a work concerned with the material, technique and process by which it is produced.
Form is the feature of a work concerned with its design, structure, genre and style as it appears to the audience.
Meaning is the feature of a work concerned with what it represents, expresses and conveys through ideas and theory.
Context and reception is the feature of a work concerned with the place, language, time, industry and audience in which it is produced and received.
Value is the feature of a work concerned with how it is judged, studied historically and assigned standing within culture.
